outcome: Cord blood levels of SIRT3, 8-OHdG, BDNF, and 5-HT
Early breast milk levels of SIRT3, 8-OHdG, BDNF, and 5-HT
cohort: 90 mothers and their infants (30 vaginal deliveries at term, 30 cesarean deliveries at term, 30 preterm births)
finding: Cord blood levels of SIRT3, BDNF and 5-HT were reduced, and 8-OHdG levels were elevated, after preterm birth compared to term birth, while breast milk levels of these biomarkers were independent of cord blood levels and showed different patterns of change based on gestational age and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with a moderate decrease in cord blood BDNF and 5-HT, but no change in SIRT3 or 8-OHdG.
